source.description:
AUDIT FINDING: xtrm-5ox1 found xtrm-tools has polluted historical 2.x versions while current latest is 0.7.17, and package self-depends on xtrm-tools ^2.0.2. Recommended direction: publish canonical scoped package @jaggerxtrm/xtrm with bins xt/xtrm, keep xtrm-tools as transition/shim, deprecate bad 2.x after smoke.

SUCCESS: Package naming/versioning is clean, scoped, and migration-safe.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Verify npm ownership/access for @jaggerxtrm/xtrm, @jaggerxtrm/xtrm-tools, xtrm, xtrm-tools.
- Decide final canonical package name (recommended @jaggerxtrm/xtrm) and version line (recommended 0.8.0 until stable).
- Remove self-dependency xtrm-tools ^2.0.2.
- Publish/prepare scoped package with bins xt/xtrm.
- Publish xtrm-tools compatibility release or shim.
- Deprecate bad xtrm-tools 2.x versions after scoped smoke.
- Update docs, workflows, install commands, and specialists prerequisite messages.
- Fresh-machine smoke proves npm install -g @jaggerxtrm/xtrm works without repo clone.
source.title: Rename: publish canonical @jaggerxtrm/xtrm package and migrate xtrm-tools
